newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares surge on, more advances possible.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares surge on, more advances possible.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Friday, buoyed by the expiry of the KFX September future with dealers seeing more gains on the horizon.

"If it had not been the expiry of the KFX September future, it would have been a rather dull day. Things have quietened down again now but there is a good chance that we will see more rises next week," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index gained 0.25 point to 122.35, while the KFX December future put on 1.15 point to close at 123.15 with 10 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Overall turnover for the day was 970 million crowns.

Holding company Sophus Berendsen was hit by its partly-owned British Rentokil's profit-taking-inspired decline in London, shedding four crowns to finish at 721 after making solid advances on Thursday.
Den Danske Bank and rival Unibank both rose two crowns to end the week at 426 and 274 crowns respectively, while Novo Nordisk climbed eight crowns to 904, breaking the technical barrier of 900.
